reason: User prioritizes demonstrated rise-error improvement before M05. Existing B underpredicts all 20 low->above26 development cases (MAE 48.771613); prior-low persistence made this worse. Compare information, training emphasis and observable probability gating separately.
event_definition: Prior maximum > 0 and floor(prior exact mean + 0.5) in [20,26], followed by target supplied rounded mean > 26. This is the inherited low->above26 transition, not every large power increase.
information_time: After observation of t-1; no reporting delay assumed as in M01. No future production, target state, maximum-day flag or target profile in inputs.

features.definitions: t-1 last-first, range and least-squares four-slot slope; t-1 minus t-2 last/mean/maximum/production; consecutive low hours backward from t-1 capped at 6, stop at first non-low or missing exact timestamp; gap flag if missing encountered before stop. Missing never bridged.

weighted.loss: fixed squared_error HGB on D input; sample weight only for training event labels
weighted.objective: inner score: max(relative overall MAE, relative daily-maximum MAE, relative rise MAE); apply stated tolerance penalties

classifier.fit_rows: Only observable prior-low training hours; unweighted binary likelihood

Logistic.scaler: StandardScaler fitted only in each training fold

classifier.objective: maximize pooled inner average precision on prior-low validation rows, tie by lower Brier then earlier trial; AP is non-interpolated average_precision_score, not trapezoidal PR-AUC
classifier.single_class: training event fraction constant, recorded; no future fallback

gate.prediction: B + I(prior_low and probability>=threshold) * blend * (W-B); exact B elsewhere
gate.objective: inner constrained error score against inner B; false positive fraction among prior-low non-events <= 0.05
gate.tuning: Use selected weighted expert and selected classifier predictions from past-only inner folds. Outer evaluation never tunes threshold, blend, C, tree settings or event weight.

development_selection.eligible_choice: Among methods satisfying all gates choose lowest max(relative overall, daily-maximum and rise MAE), within 1 percent prefer D_dynamic, then W, G_Logistic, G_HGB. If none eligible retain B and state unmet requirements. Report all candidates, not only successful results.
development_selection.interpretation: Numerical development tolerances, not measured economic optima or a guarantee of improvement; calibration and alarm metrics supplement regression results.

scope: Retrospectively motivated development, not independent final test. Stop this declared comparison after results/verification; change plans only for a concrete new question.
